observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -28
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/register",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:700].replace("\n"," | "))
    for inp in pg.locator("input").all():
        print("input:",inp.get_attribute("name"),"|",inp.get_attribute("type"),"|",(inp.get_attribute("placeholder") or "")[:30])
    print("recaptcha iframe:",[f.url[:60] for f in pg.frames if "recaptcha" in f.url])
    print("sitekey:",pg.evaluate("""()=>{const m=document.body.innerHTML.match(/6L[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{30,}/);return m?m[0]:null}"""))
    b.close()
PY
